title: OLX.ba Home
description: The market at a glance and the way into each audience board: Buy for home buyers, Rent for tenants, and Market Intelligence for agents and agencies.

panels.title: Active listings
panels.description: Open listings in every OLX real-estate category.
panels.sql:
WITH coverage AS (SELECT (min(started_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AS start FROM lean.scrape_runs), a AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NULL) AS active,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND property_type='apartments' AND deal='sale' AND ppm2>0) AS sale_ppm2,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND property_type='apartments' AND deal='rent' AND price>0) AS rent_price,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND property_type='apartments' AND deal='sale' AND price>0) AS sale_price,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND closed_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) AS exits,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) FILTER (WHERE property_type='apartments' AND deal='sale' AND ppm2>0 AND (first_seen > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND first_seen <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) AS new_window,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) FILTER (WHERE property_type='apartments' AND deal='sale' AND ppm2>0 AND (first_seen > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND first_seen <= (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) AS new_previous
  FROM lean.listings
)
SELECT active,
  round(sale_ppm2::numeric,0) AS median_sale_ppm2,
  round(rent_price::numeric,0) AS median_rent,
  round((1200 * rent_price / NULLIF(sale_price,0))::numeric,1) AS gross_yield_pct,
  round(active::numeric / NULLIF(exits * 30.0 / NULLIF(((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - GREATEST((${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date, (SELECT start FROM coverage))), 0), 0), 1) AS months_of_inventory,
  round(new_window::numeric,0) AS new_sale_ppm2,
  CASE WHEN (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) >= (SELECT start FROM coverage) THEN round(new_previous::numeric,0) END AS new_sale_ppm2_prev
FROM a

panels.title: Gross rental yield · asking
panels.description: Median monthly apartment rent × 12 ÷ median apartment sale price, both from active asking prices.

panels.title: Months of inventory
panels.description: Active listings ÷ listings that left OLX per 30 days in the selected time window: how long supply would last at that pace. Exits are not confirmed sales.

panels.title: Median KM/m² · new apartments for sale
panels.description: Apartments for sale first seen in the selected time window, compared with the window before it.

panels.title: New vs closed listings per day
panels.description: All categories. Closed means the listing disappeared from a complete search.
panels.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series(date(${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), date(${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS day), movements AS (SELECT first_seen AS day, 1 AS new_n, 0 AS closed_n FROM lean.listings UNION ALL SELECT closed_at, 0, 1 FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL) SELECT d.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time, COALESCE(sum(m.new_n),0)::int AS new_n, COALESCE(sum(m.closed_n),0)::int AS closed_n FROM days d LEFT JOIN movements m USING(day) GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day

panels.title: Data updated
panels.sql:
SELECT round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(finished_at) FILTER (WHERE status='ok' AND is_complete AND finished_at IS NOT NULL))) / 60)::int AS minutes_since_success
FROM lean.scrape_runs
panels.description: Time since the last complete OLX.ba collection run. Run details live on the Health board.
